frame0_vs_still: max channel difference, and share of pixels over 8 (sampling noise)
cut_px: per render, the px with alpha the footprint cut (E, W) cleared or thinned; the shadow is never cut
rolloff_px: per sheet but a shadow's or a light's, the px the highlight roll-off changed (brightest channel over 236, eased under 244, hue kept) and the most a channel moved; render.json's rolloff false opts out

gap.rule: in the pipe body's columns (every one), the ground (alpha <= 128) from the pipe's end back to where the building's main piece (alpha > 64, joined to the rest) covers 4 rows in a row: 2 px or more makes a gap column; more than 2 fail

beside.shadow: max channel < 40 and alpha < 224, or max channel < 20
